description: Prepare a request for manual availability review, including unverified or off-network addresses. Supply an address token from a building check, or the entered address and NYC borough. This step sends nothing. Before sending an availability inquiry, show the actual customer the address, requested bandwidth, contact details, message and returned customer data notice. Obtain explicit approval to share them with Stealth. This requests a manual review; it does not place an order, confirm availability or promise installation timing. Never infer consent from an address search or pricing inquiry.

address.description: New York City street address, including building number and street name; provide with borough instead of address_token.

address_token.description: Signed address_token or inquiry_address_token returned by check_building_availability; use this instead of address and borough.

borough.description: Borough containing the entered address; provide with address instead of address_token.

speed.description: Requested bandwidth in Gbps; use 0 or omit when the customer is not sure yet.

name: prepare_availability_inquiry
title: Prepare a manual availability inquiry
